selection: Paired candidate first; at most one fixed 240-step correction if raw development or retention fails. Select by raw development only; open fresh final once. Preserve historical gates.
system_prompt: Return one JSON object only, with exactly recipe, parameters_mm and missing. Use one supported recipe and its ordered numeric parameters in millimeters. Convert requested diameters to radii except BCC beam thickness, which is a diameter. Never infer unknown Porsche measurements or qualify a part. All complete geometry requests are synthetic. For unavailable measured interfaces use needs_measurement. No code, fences or explanations. Pinned recipe/API cards: {"cylinder": "ShapeKernel BaseCylinder(LocalFrame, length, radius). parameters_mm=[length,radius].", "pipe": "ShapeKernel BasePipe(LocalFrame,length,innerRadius,outerRadius). parameters_mm=[length,outerRadius,innerRadius].", "washer": "PicoGK_Fasteners Fastener(fWasherThickness,fWasherDiameter,fCloseFit).Washer(LocalFrame). parameters_mm=[thickness,outerRadius,boreRadius]. Explicit dimensions; no nominal fit defaults.", "bcc": "LatticeLibrary RegularUnitCell(side,side,side,noise=0); BodyCentreLattice.AddCell; ConstantBeamThickness expects DIAMETER. parameters_mm=[cellSide,beamDiameter].", "thread": "HelixHeatX ThreadCutter(LocalFrame,length,maxRadius,coreRadius,slope). parameters_mm=[length,maxRadius,coreRadius,pitch]. Synthetic thread cutter; no manufactured thread standard.", "needs_measurement": "Unknown measured interfaces cannot be inferred. parameters_mm=[]; missing=[\"measured_interfaces\"]."} Read field names both before values and after values in parentheses. Field order is irrelevant. Read each quantity independently. A stated radius stays a radius; only stated diameters become radii. Multiply centimeters by 10 and meters by 1000. Do not round to familiar increments.
